method: Weighted multi-criteria decision analysis with seeded sensitivity scenarios. Ratings are editorial judgments informed by the cited public product documentation and the existing repository, not measured demand or predicted success probabilities.

ideas.name: One next step, with its source and honest remaining work
ideas.rationale: Connect existing evidence verification to a returning action card, explicit step completion, and remaining-work-only recovery. Reuses checked Lens scheduling. Relevant-now recommendations and progress tracking already exist in competitors; the specific evidence-bound student recovery flow is the hypothesis to test, not a world-first claim.

ideas.name: Review the one deadline ambiguity that blocks action
ideas.rationale: Lens already asks source-conflict questions. Ranking questions by downstream scheduling effect may reduce effort, but requires broader multi-task dependency modeling and testing.

ideas.name: Stress-test a plan against underestimated effort
ideas.rationale: Useful, but Shovel already describes Cushion/spare study time and Motion surfaces deadline risk. Extra reserve numbers could complicate the default screen.

ideas.name: Generate a smaller first action
ideas.rationale: A familiar category; Goblin Tools already offers small AI-powered task tools. Lens can schedule a short step without claiming to know a course-specific solution.

ideas.name: Coordinate a shared recovery session with a peer
ideas.rationale: Potential accountability benefit, but needs another participant, invitations, shared permissions, and validated availability. High coordination cost before first value.

ideas.name: Conversational assistant across every task and calendar
ideas.rationale: Crowded, broad scope. Reclaim already brings task integrations, memory, and natural-language recommendations together. Adds authentication and reliability dependencies.
